features.note: Lifesaving instruction in the camp's private lake.
A private lake on the property.
An ecology and conservation programme area.
Scouts can attend individually through the provisional programme.
Whitewater rafting on the world-class Kern River, the camp's featured high-adventure activity.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident summer camp operated by the Western Los Angeles County Council, set in the Sequoia National Forest near Kernville, California.

sources.citation: Community correction via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by council staff 2026-08-19 (submission Vp42YBg); submitter requested credit but provided only an email, which is withheld. Added whitewater_rafting (featured) plus specific shooting, aquatics, scoutcraft, and facility activities, verified against the camp's own traditional-summer-camp page. Removed high_adventure_option and outpost_overnight: the council's Camping Registrar confirmed by email 2026-08-20 that the High Adventure and outpost-night programs have not been offered since before the pandemic (the camp's own website still listed them but is stale).

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
